source: 墨问岐黄_十问与问舟旁白_v1.10
note: Buttons only. Mentor cues ask what you missed; never name a diagnosis.

questions.zh: 怕冷还是怕热？发热多久？恶风吗？
questions.en: Chills or heat? How long? Afraid of wind?
questions.ja: 寒け？熱っぽい？いつから？風を嫌う？

questions.zh: 有汗无汗？汗出在何时、何部位？
头何处痛？身重还是身痛？腰腿如何？
questions.en: Where does the head hurt? Heavy or aching body?
questions.ja: 頭のどこが痛む？体は重い？腰脚は？

questions.zh: 大便干稀次数？小便色次？
questions.en: Stool dry or loose? How often? Urine color?
questions.ja: 便の状態と回数は？尿の色と回数は？

questions.zh: 能吃吗？口淡油腻？饭后胀不胀？
questions.en: Appetite? Bland or greasy mouth? Bloat after meals?
questions.ja: 食欲は？口は淡い？食後に脹る？

questions.en: Chest or flank distension? Palpitation, wheeze, cough?
questions.ja: 胸脇が張る？動悸・喘・咳は？

questions.en: Tinnitus or deafness? Blurry or red eyes?
questions.ja: 耳鳴り？目のかすみ・充血は？

questions.zh: 口渴吗？想不想饮？喜热喜冷？
questions.en: Thirsty? Want drinks? Prefer hot or cold?
questions.ja: 渇きは？飲みたい？熱いの／冷たいの？

questions.zh: 以前得过什么？一直吃什么方？
questions.en: Past illnesses? Any formulas you keep taking?
questions.ja: 以前の病は？常用している方は？

questions.zh: 从什么时候、因什么起的？
questions.en: Since when, and what started it?
questions.ja: いつから、何がきっかけ？

extra.zh: 周期准不准？身上困重绵绵？
extra.en: Cycle regular? Heavy or lingering fatigue?
extra.ja: 周期は安定？体が重だるい？

extra.zh: 问乳食、问睡、问是否受惊，问大人核实
extra.en: Ask milk/food, sleep, fright; verify with an adult.
extra.ja: 乳食・睡眠・驚きを問い、大人に確認

missing_look: 人还没进门，你倒先开柜了。
先看他眼睛愿不愿看你。
missing_tongue: 舌上的苔，比他自己说的老实。
missing_listen: 他进门那口气，你听了吗。
咳在喉还是在胸，隔着门也能辨。
missing_pulse: 脉枕擦过了，手还没按下。
never_say: 禁止把气机图上的滞说破
